title: Power of Attorney Record Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=poa:record
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(poa_type) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many power of attorney record events land each day and how many distinct POA type values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest power of attorney record records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct POA type values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how much power of attorney record activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
